description: Start the Buoy Optimize clock. Pass how long the session lasts (`minutes`) or when it ends (`deadline`, ISO time). After this, every Buoy tool result shows the time left, so the loop keeps going until the deadline. Call it once at the start of an optimize session. Pass minutes: 0 to stop the clock.

deadline.description: When the session ends, as an ISO time, e.g. 2026-10-04T07:12:00-06:00.

minutes.description: Session length from now, in minutes.

name: start_optimize_session
